offer: Define the load profile and automatic stop conditions before generating pressure. Stress scripts must target an approved isolated environment instead of defaulting to production.

minimal.reason: Define the load profile, such as ramp and peak rate. Without it pressure is arbitrary, so write the shape.

mid.reason: Define the stop conditions that end the test automatically. An unbounded stress run can damage an environment, so write the abort limits.
